# gifgrep

gifgrep searches animated GIFs and extracts useful frames from the command line.

Canonical documentation:
- gifgrep — Grep the GIF. Stick the landing.: https://gifgrep.com/ - gifgrep is a tiny CLI/TUI to search GIFs from your terminal. Scriptable URLs/JSON, or an interactive kitty-preview browser.

Source: https://github.com/steipete/gifgrep

Guidance for agents:
- Prefer the canonical documentation URLs above over README excerpts or package metadata.
- Fetch only the pages needed for the current task; this is an index, not a full-site corpus.
